public-evidence-snapshot.rationale: The only population whose size and breadth can carry an evidence floor (cases, axes, twin pairs, fixture-profile cells). Its denominators are read as published, never topped up from another population.

regression-corpus.rationale: Product-authored regressions guard behavior already shipped. They add zero-tolerance gates (a twin or benign failure here blocks stable) and never add to a floor, because their cases were authored to pin one defect each and would inflate a count they were not authored to measure.

policy-corpus.rationale: The bounded behavior contract of the four policy-qualified families. It feeds only the T3 policy-qualified route, whose gates are defined in benchmarks/support/policy-qualified-credentials.json; it never counts toward the documented or empirical routes.

differential.rationale: The differential gate reads the peers the legacy gate read: gitleaks and trufflehog, each against the redact-secret reference. flare-redact and openredaction are measured by the methods run and reported per family (families[].differential), but are not gate-bearing: the legacy gate never read them, no one has reviewed their disagreements, and counting them would add occurrences with no decision to a gate that never had them, which changes the qualification semantics. A peer joins this list only through a reviewed decision of its own.

attribution.rationale: A public case is attributed to the product detectors its snapshot targets, family or taxonomy family name. Where the snapshot names none, the legacy rule applies: a fixture was scoped to the detectors in its declared targets, which the product-owned overlay carries per case (benchmarks/support/public-axis-overlay.json detectors); then a twin is scoped to the family it twins (the detectors of its parent). A case that still maps to none stays unattributed and is counted, never dropped. Populations are never pooled to reach a floor: floors read the floors-and-gates population alone.

rules: One artifact is one population. Counts stay per population, keyed by (population, case id), and are never summed, averaged or pooled into one rate.
Floors and fixture-profile cells are read from the floors-and-gates population only.
A zero-tolerance gate (twin failures, benign false alarms) is evaluated in each gate-bearing population on its own; the classifier receives the worst population, never a sum.
The policy-route population feeds only the T3 policy-qualified route.

The differential gate reads the peers named in methods.differential.peers; a differential occurrence of another peer is measured and reported but never counts toward the gate. A legacy review decision applies to a canonical occurrence only through the generated mapping (benchmarks/support/public-review-ledger-map.json): same case, same peer, same disagreement property, same bytes; an unmapped occurrence is unreviewed.

A method that did not run is unmeasured, never zero failures. The methods come from the methods run, a second official artifact of the floors-and-gates population (manifest.methods), attributed to a family through the seed case of each assertion or review occurrence; a family that would be stable is held at provisional until every required method has run.

A counted case is named by the axis the product authored for it: the public axis overlay (benchmarks/support/public-axis-overlay.json, generated from the legacy development fixtures, bound to one snapshot by corpus digest) gives the source-context group of a positive and the benign taxonomy of a control; a case the overlay does not name keeps the snapshot's own group or taxonomy. The overlay changes no evidence class, outcome or count, and the evidence class of a case is never a support status.
The route (documented, empirical, policy-qualified) is read from the product contract and empirical overlays, never from the evidence class a case carries.
A view is public only when every contributing artifact is publication public and its population is publishable; one internal artifact makes the whole view internal.
